name: Cheryong Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: Cheryong Electric Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells power electric equipment in South Korea. It offers transformers, such as amorphous, solid insulation distribution, power oil immersed, cast resin, PAD mounted, pole mounted, autotransformer, seismic withstanding cast resin, submersible, and solid insulation overhead. It also provides gas insulated switchgear for power transmission and distribution, and metro railways applications; and polymer lightning arrester and hybrid cutout switch. The company was formerly known as Cheryong Industrial and changed its name to Cheryong Electric Co.,Ltd. in November 2011.
